'''Loyada''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Carrick Station]], he also shared his knowledge of diplomacy with others.
